tweets.text:
A Citadel intern sitting next to me at a coworking space wouldn't stop staring at my screen

I was running my bot. Three panels open. Trades scrolling. He had a Citadel badge clipped to his backpack.

He finally said something.

"Is that a live execution system"

It's a prediction market bot. Claude Code. Four repos. Costs me $25 a month.

"We spend more than that on a single API call"

I pulled up my stats. 214 trades. 74% win rate. +$9,400 in 19 days.

He put his phone down.

"What's the data source"

I showed him.

https://t.co/wdX3ih0mh1

86 million trades. Full wallet history. Every entry. Every exit. Completely open.

"You're kidding. We have a whole team sourcing this exact type of data. It's a seven-figure line item"

The model reads the wallets that consistently win. Then it reverse-engineers what they do differently. No training. No fine-tuning. Just Claude Code pointed at raw trade history.

He asked what the edge actually is.

Exits. Everyone focuses on entries. But the wallets that make money exit before resolution 86% of the time. The rest hold to 58%. That gap is the whole game.

My bot exits at 85% of expected move. Or when volume spikes 3x. First trigger wins.

"How did you figure out those thresholds"

I didn't. Claude found them in the data.

https://t.co/QcMKRXpiKr

Three commands to connect. 500 markets. Claude scores all of them in 20 minutes.

Full setup:
Claude API - $20/mo
VPS - $5/mo
poly_data - free
polymarket-cli - free

He sat there reading my screen for a while. Then he said something quiet.

"If my PM finds out this exists I'm going to have a very uncomfortable conversation"

Too late.
